concept: A receipt told in herdr's own colors: the wordmark arrives like the product booting, the star curve proves momentum, the real terminal shows the glanceable state view, the count lands the scale, the fix names the pain it kills, the close commands the herd.
money_shot_note: The 26-count-up big_number at 60% of runtime: the number IS the argument, so it gets the count-up, the hit, and the flash.
transition_strategy: fade-through with accelerating exits; chromatic tick on every cut; emphasize flash reserved for the money shot and the close
music_direction: district-four (already recorded for today), electronic, cuts snapped to onsets by beat_align

scenes.intent: recognition hook: herdr's wordmark in its own colors doubles as the muted-autoplay poster frame
momentum proof: the star curve drawing itself is the receipt, not an adjective
scenes.copy_note: climbing curve, end value 9.1k, velocity caption

scenes.intent: the product surface itself: rack focus lands on the live state view, typed like a real session
scenes.copy_note: herdr up, then three agents with their states at a glance
scenes.sound_cue: typing ticks ducked under the bed

scenes.intent: the scale lands: count-up to 26 makes breadth felt, not stated
scenes.copy_note: 26 counting up, supported agents named small
scenes.sound_cue: hard hit as the count lands

scenes.intent: name the pain it kills: the blocked agent you did not notice
closing command that rhymes with the open so the loop replays clean
scenes.copy_note: herd them all, binary honesty in the subtitle
